edges.reason: release forwards Ether to the payee through Address.sendValue low-level call, transferring control to an external address.
tokenTransfer performs an external ERC20 transfer that can re-enter the contract.
tokenRescue reads the token balance once and then executes external transfers in a loop, allowing a malicious token to re-enter tokenRescue.
tokenRescue invokes the private tokenTransfer helper for each payee.
tokenRescue calls the shares getter for authorization and share computation.
tokenRescue calls the payee getter to obtain transfer recipients.
tokenRescue calls totalShares to scale each payee amount.
tokenRescue reads _shares through shares() for the caller check and proportionality.
tokenRescue iterates over the _payees array.
tokenRescue authorization depends on untrusted msg.sender having a non-zero share balance.
receive emits an event carrying the untrusted _msgSender() address.
release requires and reads _shares[account] to determine the entitlement.
release reads and updates _released[account] before the external call.
release reads and updates the _totalReleased accumulator.
release divides by _totalShares when computing the payee payment.
payment is computed by multiplying the total received by _shares[account].
payment subtracts _released[account]; underflow would revert without a prior check.
totalReceived is used to derive the payment value.
the payment amount is passed to the external Ether transfer.
the account parameter selects the payee whose shares and releases are read.
_addPayee increases _totalShares by the new payee shares.
_addPayee writes the new share balance into _shares.
_addPayee pushes the new payee address into _payees.
the constructor loops over the provided arrays and calls _addPayee.
the token parameter determines which ERC20 contract is queried and drained.
the token parameter is the target of the external safeTransfer call.
the recipient parameter is forwarded to the token transfer.
the amount parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.
the token balance amount scales the proportional transfer value.
the loop index drives iteration over the payee list.

normalization_plan.reason: account is only used inside release to index _shares and _released and to receive Ether.
token is only used inside tokenRescue for balanceOf and subsequent transfers.
recipient is only meaningful as an argument of the tokenTransfer external transfer.
amount is only consumed by the tokenTransfer external call.
payment is the value handed to the external Ether transfer in release.
totalReceived exists only to compute the payment inside release.
amount is the cached token balance read by tokenRescue before the transfer loop.
i is the loop counter used only within tokenRescue.
